seo.title: DevHub.md — Software development, websites and apps in Moldova
seo.description: Software development studio based in Moldova. We build business websites, web and mobile apps, online stores and custom software for companies.

hero.text: We build websites, web and mobile apps and custom software for businesses that want to grow. Clean code, fast interfaces, no unnecessary complexity.

sites.title: Business websites
sites.text: Fast, SEO-ready, mobile-friendly websites that explain your business clearly and bring in new leads.

apps.title: Web apps and SaaS
apps.text: Platforms with user accounts, subscriptions, payments and an admin panel, designed to scale.

mobile.title: Mobile apps
mobile.text: Android and iOS apps built with React Native from a single codebase.

shops.title: Online stores
shops.text: Catalog, cart, online payments and order management — everything you need to sell online.

custom.title: Custom software
custom.text: CRMs, automations and integrations built around the way your business actually works.

speed.title: Speed
speed.text: Websites and apps that load fast on any connection and any device.

seo.title: SEO from day one
seo.text: Structure, metadata and structured data planned from the start, not bolted on at the end.

mobile.title: Mobile first
mobile.text: We design for the small screen first, where most visitors come from.

code.title: Clean code
code.text: Clear, extensible code, so the product can grow without rewrites.

brief.title: Brief
brief.text: We define the goals, the audience and what the product needs to do.

design.title: Design
design.text: We sketch the structure and interface before writing any code.

build.title: Build
build.text: We work in short iterations, so you see progress along the way.

launch.title: Launch
launch.text: We ship, measure and improve based on real data.

time.q: How long does a business website take?
time.a: Usually 1–2 weeks, depending on the number of pages and how quickly the copy and images are ready. For web and mobile apps we agree on a phased plan after the first call.

mobile.a: Yes. We build Android and iOS apps with React Native, so a single codebase runs on both platforms.

seo.q: Will the website be optimized for Google?
seo.a: Yes. Every site is fast, mobile-friendly and has the technical structure SEO needs: metadata, a sitemap, structured data and separate URLs for each language.

languages.q: Can you build a multilingual website?
languages.a: Yes, for example in Romanian, Russian and English. Each language gets its own pages, so the site shows up in search in every language.

stack.a: Vue, Nuxt, React and Next.js for interfaces, Laravel and PHP for the backend, MySQL or PostgreSQL for data, Docker for delivery and React Native for mobile apps. We choose based on the project.
